product.olivetti-laptop-lx4-c.summary: The LX4/C put a TFT-equipped 486 at the top of Olivetti 1.
product.olivetti-laptop-lx4-c.history: MCmicrocomputer described the LX4/C in 1992 on the D33/C chassis and placed it at the top of Olivetti 1.
product.olivetti-laptop-lx4-c.architectu: The 1992 reports describe different configurations. MCmicrocomputer listed a 25 MHz 486DX in May and a 50 MHz 486DX2 in November.
product.olivetti-laptop-lx4-c.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-laptop-lx4-c.limitation: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
